name: map-constant-negative-test-0be5e94915/constant-map-spread-field-negative-e.bal
reason: The case asserts rejection of duplicate mapping keys introduced by spread fields in constant map constructors, while also requiring a valid spread clone. Spread fields are explicitly unsupported, so the asserted duplicate-key behavior depends on an unsupported construct.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping-constructor spread fields (...CMS1, ...CMS2), including in constant initializers
test_design_notes: Four @error annotations assert duplicate-key rejection involving spread fields; CMS1_CLONE also requires acceptance of a non-conflicting spread field.
